exposure: Exteriorized uterine repair during Caesarean delivery
In situ uterine repair during Caesarean delivery
outcome: Time taken for uterine incision closure
cohort: 200 pregnant women who underwent elective lower segment Caesarean section (LSCS) in Sree Mookambika Institute of Medical Sciences.
finding: Both exteriorized and in situ uterine repair groups showed similar safety and morbidity profiles, although the in situ repair group had a longer uterine incision closure time and slightly higher overall complications.
mod_finding: The study found that in situ uterine repair resulted in longer incision closure time and slightly higher overall complications compared to exteriorized repair during Caesarean section, but both techniques showed similar safety and morbidity profiles.
